walkthroughs.body_html:
Liturgical worship follows a set order — e.g. Church of England Common Worship, Roman Catholic Mass, Orthodox Divine Liturgy.

Non-liturgical services are freer — Methodists, Baptists, Pentecostals. There's still structure (hymns, sermon, prayer) but it's flexible.

Both aim to glorify God, build community, and teach scripture.

Private worship happens at home or alone.

It includes prayer, Bible reading, meditation, and family devotion.

Matthew 6:6 — 'When you pray, go into your room, close the door and pray to your Father, who is unseen.'

The Lord's Prayer is the model Jesus gave (Matthew 6, Luke 11): 'Our Father in heaven, hallowed be your name.'

Set prayers are written and shared. Extempore prayers are made up on the spot — common in Pentecostal worship.

Prayer can be: praise, confession, thanksgiving, and petition (asking).

mcqs.q: What is the doctrine of the Trinity?
options: God is one being existing in three persons (Father, Son, Holy Spirit) — distinct in person but united in essence; Christians remain monotheistic.
Christians believe in three different gods.
The Trinity refers to heaven, earth and hell.
The design argument proves evolution is false.

mcqs.q: What do Christians mean by resurrection, and how does it differ from reincarnation?
options: Resurrection and reincarnation are basically the same idea of life after death.
Christians believe everyone is reincarnated until they accept Jesus.

Resurrection is the once-for-all bodily raising to eternal life at the end of time (modelled on Christ's resurrection); reincarnation is the soul's repeated rebirth into new bodies. They are distinct doctrines from different religious traditions.
The Trinity refers to heaven, earth and hell.

mcqs.q: What does the teleological (design) argument claim?
options: The design argument proves God created the world in seven days.
The Trinity refers to heaven, earth and hell.
Apparent purpose, order or complexity in the universe implies an intelligent designer — Paley's watchmaker analogy is the classic example.
The design argument proves evolution is false.
